items.title: Why AI carbon footprinting tools are prone to misleading results
items.summary: Multiple services now offer to take a list of the materials that go into a product — or even just a description of it — and estimate the emissions generated by its manufacture.

items.title: El Niño: A live stress test for UK supply chain resilience
items.summary: With a quarter of UK food imports now exposed to the 'supersized' El Niño, a new report from the Nation Audit Office (NAO) has warned that the country must do more to protect its food supply chain from such shocks.

items.title: Companies with climate targets barely outspend peers on green CapEx, study finds
items.summary: New research into corporate climate targets has found that setting a more ambitious emissions goal does not necessarily lead companies to spend more on the investments needed to achieve it.

items.title: 45-minute Masterclass: The Future Cost of EV Charging
items.summary: Event Date: 22/10/2026 | 11:00 am UK | 6:00 am US East Coast ET | 3:00 am US West Coast PT | 12:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST Join our 45-minute masterclass, 'The Future Cost of EV Charging,' presented by edie webinar and sponsored by Brook Green Supply.

items.title: edie launches four insight reports exploring the audiences and opportunities at edie 27
items.summary: edie has published four new insight reports for its flagship edie 27 event, bringing together audience data and market research to help solution providers, exhibitors and sponsors explore partnership opportunities across the show's four new zones.

items.title: REPORT: edie 27 insight report – Energy
items.summary: With factors such as geopolitical uncertainty and market volatility increasingly affecting the energy transition in the run-up to 2050, organisations are at the frontline of driving a just, effective transition.

items.title: REPORT: edie 27 insight report – Climate resilience & nature
items.summary: Investing in climate resilience and nature is increasingly an integral part of sustainable business. edie 27 is where those organisations will meet the market.

items.title: REPORT: edie 27 insight report – Supply chains & circularity
items.summary: The next wave of sustainable business is coming – and it will be shaped by the organisations helping companies adapt faster, build resilience and turn sustainability into practical, commercial action.

items.title: REPORT: edie 27 insight report – Reporting & engagement
items.summary: As geopolitical events and agendas continue to shape business strategy, the field of sustainability will increasingly be shaped by the organisations helping companies prove progress, build trust and turn sustainability data into credible action.

items.title: Coffee biofuels and seaweed CO2 capture: The best green innovations of August 2026
items.summary: As the summer comes to an end, edie and our sister title Springwise take a look at six of the month's most exciting cleantech innovation stories, from biofuels made from coffee grounds to a carbon-capturing seaweed solution.
